label: MODELLED — a holdover test scored from a time-error record the operator supplied. Every limit is transcribed from the named public ITU-T Recommendation and the result is measured against the mask; it says nothing about whether any clock or system meets a Recommendation, and nobody has rated or approved it. The times at which GNSS was removed and restored are the operator's statement and are not verified. Advisory software, not type-approved equipment.

masks.not_specified: G.8272 states no holdover requirement for a PRTC
masks.title: Primary reference time clock, class A (PRTC-A)

checks.note: limit_ns is the envelope at the end of the holdover period; margin_ns is the smallest margin inside it; worst_tau_s is the time to exceed, when the envelope is exceeded

masks.not_specified: MTIE and TDEV beyond 10 000 s in holdover, and every ePRTC-B holdover requirement, are for further study
masks.title: Enhanced primary reference time clock, class A (ePRTC-A), holdover

not_covered: whether GNSS was in fact removed and restored at the stated times: they are the operator's statement
any step the operator did not record: a record that ends before a mask's range is INCOMPLETE, never extrapolated
the masks of G.8273.2 and G.8271.1 that are defined through a 0.1 Hz low-pass filter, for a record sampled slower than once a second
a measurement-chain uncertainty: the record is taken as the instrument logged it, with no allowance for the instrument's own error
a test of a clock class that needs a procedure the Recommendation sets beyond a time-error record (temperature profiles, packet-network load)

test.stated_by: the operator; not verified by Kshana

budgets[].max_abs_te_ns.note: the budget: a maximum absolute time error from the named source

budgets[].time_to_exceed_s.note: first time after the start of holdover (or of the record) at which |TE| is above the budget, at the sample resolution

curves[].mtie_ns.note: maximum time interval error of the step at that observation interval

curves[].tau_s.note: observation interval of an MTIE and TDEV point

curves[].tdev_ns.note: time deviation of the step at that observation interval

holdover.duration_s.note: time from the first to the last sample of the holdover step

holdover.fit_intercept_ns.note: the least-squares line's value at the start of the holdover step

holdover.fit_residual_rms_ns.note: root-mean-square distance of the holdover time error from the least-squares line

holdover.frequency_offset_ppb.note: slope of the least-squares line through the holdover time error: the fractional frequency offset the system held, in parts per billion (1 ns/s)

holdover.step_at_removal_ns.note: absolute change of the time error between the last baseline sample and the first holdover sample

holdover.te_at_max_abs_ns.note: the signed time error at that sample

holdover.time_of_max_abs_te_s.note: time after GNSS removal of the largest absolute time error

holdover_envelope.holdover_period_s.note: holdover period H G.8272.1 Table 3 assigns to that locked duration

holdover_envelope.locked_duration_days.note: locked-mode duration before the loss, L in G.8272.1 Table 3

holdover_envelope.min_margin_ns.note: smallest envelope minus |TE| inside the holdover period

holdover_envelope.time_to_exceed_s.note: first time after the start of holdover at which |TE| is above the ePRTC-A envelope, at the sample resolution

masks[].checks[].limit_ns.note: the limit the transcribed ITU-T table or clause states at the binding point

masks[].checks[].margin_ns.note: limit minus value at the binding point, the smallest over the curve; negative on a FAIL

masks[].checks[].points_evaluated.note: curve points that fell inside the mask's observation-interval range

masks[].checks[].value_ns.note: the measured quantity at the binding point (filtered where the mask says so)

masks[].checks[].worst_tau_s.note: observation interval of the binding point (for the holdover envelope, the time to exceed it)

record.n_samples.note: number of time-error samples in the record

record.record_length_s.note: time from the first to the last sample

record.start_s.note: time stamp of the first sample

recovery.final_abs_te_ns.note: absolute time error at the last sample

recovery.largest_step_ns.note: largest change between consecutive samples from the last holdover sample to the end of the record

recovery.peak_abs_te_ns.note: largest absolute time error after GNSS restoration

recovery.time_to_recover_s.note: time from GNSS restoration to the start of the first stay inside the recovery band that lasts the dwell time

steps[].end_s.note: time of the last sample of the step

steps[].first_te_ns.note: time error at the first sample of the step

steps[].last_te_ns.note: time error at the last sample of the step

steps[].max_abs_te_ns.note: largest absolute time error over the step

steps[].mean_te_ns.note: mean time error over the step

steps[].rms_te_ns.note: root-mean-square time error over the step

steps[].start_s.note: time of the first sample of the step

test.gnss_removed_s.note: time the operator states GNSS was removed, on the record's time axis

test.gnss_restored_s.note: time the operator states GNSS was restored, on the record's time axis

test.locked_duration_days.note: how long the system had been locked before GNSS was removed, which sets the ePRTC-A holdover period

test.recovery_band_ns.note: |TE| at or below this counts as recovered

test.recovery_dwell_s.note: |TE| must stay inside the recovery band this long to count as recovered

fixture_note: SHAPE FIXTURE for reviewing the drawing: the engine's recorded result with record.series filled from the scenario's own record by a review script; not engine output until the engine writes record.series
